qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in seamless OCTG steel pipe with innovative Rig Direct logistics, but products are ultimately cyclical industrial materials whose pricing and margins swing wildly with global rig counts, steel costs, and oil capex cycles. 10-year median ROIC is ~5%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). OCTG seamless pipe manufacturer is a commodity cyclical price-taker across the full cycle. 10-year median ROIC is ~5% with negative returns in cyclical troughs (-0.4% in 2016, -3.9% in 2020), despite conservative net cash balance sheet and Rig Direct integration.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC is ~4.6-5.0%. Even with superior execution and $3.8B net cash, returns on capital fluctuate violently from negative during oil busts (2016, 2020) to mid-teens only during peak commodity crunches (2022-2023), confirming lack of structural pricing power above inflation.
